from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Summon Lightning Golem''' is a [[minion]] [[spell]], summoning a [[Golem]] that grants the player increased [[attack speed|attack]] and [[cast speed]] and flat [[mana]] regen while active. It can use a long range lightning spell projectile, place orbs of lightning that strikes nearby enemies rapidly, and a temporary aura that adds a small amount of lightning damage to attacks and spells. ==Abilities== * '''Galvanic Bolt''': Projectile spell, 100% lightning, supported with spell/projectile supports. * '''Orb of Sparks''': Stationary spell similar to [[Orb of Storms]], 100% lightning, hits only one enemy per zap and is unable to chain, supported by spell/AoE supports but unaffected by AoE damage. * '''Storm Nimbus''': Temporary aura that adds lightning damage to attacks and spells, lasts 4 seconds, uses default aura radius. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Mana

Summoned Lightning Golems now have 20% more Life inherently. * Quality now provides 0-20% increased Buff Effect, instead of causing Minions to deal 0-20% increased Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * The damage and life scaling values for minions have been adjusted. Generally speaking, minion life and damage is unchanged in the very early game, roughly 30% lower in mid acts, roughly 20% lower at level 20 of the minion skill, and roughly 10% lower at level 30 of the minion skill. * Gem quality no longer grants 0–20% increased Minion Maximum Life. * Now has 30% more base life at all levels. Now has 0% increased Minion Maximum Life at gem level 1 (previously 30%), up to 38% at gem level 20 (previously 68%). * Golem spells now have 6% base Critical Strike chance (previously 5%). * The basic lightning projectile spell now has an Added Damage Effectiveness of 250% (previously 100%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * The damage dealt by Flame, Ice and Lightning Golems has been increased by roughly 30% at all gem levels. * Carrion, Chaos, Flame, Ice and Lightning Golems now regenerate 1% of their Life per second. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Lightning Golem now has an aggro range of 50. }} {{Version history table row|2.4.2| * Fixed a bug where Summon Lightning Golem was not triggerable with Mjölner. }} {{Version history table row|2.2.2b| * Fixed a client crash that could occur when Lightning Golem was used in predictive mode. }} {{Version history table row|2.2.2| * Summon Lightning Golem has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
